text:
Predicates:
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
MountainRange(x) ::: x is a mountain range.
Visited(x, y) ::: x visited y.
Mine(x) ::: x is a mine.
Donated(x) ::: x has been donated.
HasMineInRange(x, y) ::: mountain range y has a mine x.
InTexas(x) ::: x is in Texas.
InNewMexico(x) ::: x is in New Mexico.

Premises:
PicurisMountains(x) ∧ MountainRange(x) ::: The Picuris Mountains are a mountain range.
Visited(juanDeOnate, x) ::: Juan de Onate visited the Picuris Mountains.
Mine(hardingPegmatite) ∧ LocatedIn(hardingPegmatite, x) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine is located in x.
Donated(hardingPegmatite) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine was donated.
∀x (MountainRange(x) ∧ HasMineInRange(x, y) → (InTexas(x) ∧ ∃z (Mine(z) ∧ LocatedIn(z, x) ∧ Donated(z)))) ::: No mountain ranges in Texas have donated mines.

Conclusion:
¬LocatedIn(hardingPegmatite, x) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine is not located in x.
